wmdr:Description.wmdr:description: The station was originally registered based on WMO Pub 9 Vol A information containing these observation remarks: A;AUT;CLIMAT(C);GSN;GUAN;METAR;RBCN;RBSN(S);SOLRA;SUNDUR;WN (see code table A for explanations).
